_comment: Allow-list of ProjectReference edges, keyed by dependent -> [dependencies it may reference]. Seeded from the graph as of 2026-08-21 (aln.gauntlet setup) - review and tighten by hand; this only guarantees no NEW violations creep in, it does not vouch for the existing graph being correct.
_api_generation_edges_note: Modeller.Api -> {Modeller.Generation, Modeller.Templates, Modeller.Rendering} added 2026-08-26 for issue #134 (POST /v1/workspace/generate). This is a deliberate edge, not a shortcut: docs/architecture/decisions/generation-preview-panel.mdx (Accepted) specifies a 'plan + render, no write' endpoint calling GenerationPlanner.Plan and template rendering directly, precisely because that pipeline has no filesystem write step until a separate application stage. Modeller.GenerationWorkflow was not used instead because its only entry point (GenerationExecution.ExecuteAsync) unconditionally performs Modeller.Output's filesystem-write step, which conflicts with the ADR's stateless/no-write requirement - going through it would mean either writing to disk in a hosted preview or forking its contract. Enforced going forward by tests/Modeller.ArchitectureTests: Modeller.Api must never reference Modeller.Output or Modeller.GenerationWorkflow, so the read-only invariant can't silently regress.
